# Function.InvokeAfter

```m
Function.InvokeAfter(function as function, delay as duration) as any
```

Returns the result of invoking `function` after duration `delay` has passed.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Optional |
|---|---|---|
| `function` | `function` | no |
| `delay` | `duration` | no |
